name: Sampler
description: SAMPLER.LIKE.AUDIO — a drum sampler and 16-step sequencer that runs entirely in the browser. Sixteen velocity pads over a loaded sample folder, chop and pitch, a sequencer, a channel-strip mixer with effects, and a sound browser. One bundle compiled from the sources in sources.json by build.mjs; the plugin tests run before the compile and a red test leaves the last good bundle in place. Publishes pad assignments on APK.audio/Gui/DrumKit/<pad>/sample (every topic and payload: libControl/App/oaTopics.js) and runs standalone against a mock when no broker is there.
